description: An original-language sentence \(A\) has an accepted certified proof code exactly when the existing first-order natural-deduction calculus derives \(A\) from the theory supplied by \(E\).
signature:
Lemmatheca.ProofTheory.CodingFormalProofs.certificate_iff_derives.{u, v} {L : FirstOrder.Language}
  (S : Lemmatheca.ProofTheory.CodingFormalProofs.EffectiveSignature L) (E : ℕ → ℕ → Bool) (A : L.Sentence) :
  (∃ p,
      Lemmatheca.ProofTheory.CodingFormalProofs.certificateCheck S E p
          (Lemmatheca.ProofTheory.CodingFormalProofs.sentenceCode S A) =
        true) ↔
    Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.FirstOrderProofs.Derives (Lemmatheca.ProofTheory.CodingFormalProofs.theory S E) A
